sentence: This project uses an eye imaging instrument to study the causes and treatments of diseases such as macular degeneration and cataract.
This project supports cancer research by providing biostatistical, bioinformatics and clinical informatics help with data analyses.
This project builds a classifier that uses computer vision and deep learning to make a histological diagnosis of lupus nephritis.
This project looks at why some population groups suffer more dental diseases, using bioinformatics and data science.
This project builds molecular tools for editing genes and overexpression in Pneumocystis, a pathogen that cannot be grown outside the mammalian lung.
This project studies how HIV-infected cells that persist on medicines differ and how they contribute to inflammation and virus relapse.
This project screens chemical matter to find leads for antiviral drugs, using high throughput screening and computational virtual screening.
This project tries to find out why indisulam works so well against high-risk neuroblastoma and tests combination therapies in preclinical models.
This project applies computational methods to complex biological questions about diabetes, obesity and related metabolic diseases.
This project provides equipment for preparing tissue samples, imaging them with microscopes and turning the images into numerical data.
This project provides biostatistical, bioinformatic and systems biology services to support research on HIV cure, prevention and response to treatment.
This project looks for immune and metabolic profiles during pregnancy that signal risk of neurodevelopmental disorders in children.
This project studies how a signaling pathway controls the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier and how this affects cell metabolism and behavior.
This project studies how three families of bacterial toxins cause disease, to clarify the role of the actin machinery in defense against microorganisms.
This project tests whether the Retinoic Acid signaling pathway can help cone photoreceptors survive and improve visual acuity in mouse models of Retinitis Pigmentosa.
This project builds a risk assessment tool that predicts breast cancer risk in women of African descent from genes, environment and lifestyle.
This project works to improve survival for children, adolescents and young adults with blood cancers and lymphoma through faster clinical trials.
This project uses single-cell methods to study how different cell states and their changes build and maintain tumors.
